title: Backend tests for `handleMoveRepo()` and enriched `handleGetRepo()`
description:
Plan Context: Replace the inline add form and full-page detail editor with a single shared modal dialog that supports moving repositories between stores via a dropdown integrated into the save flow.

Description: Add test coverage for the new move endpoint and the enriched GET response in the existing `api-repos-store.test.ts` test file.

Scope:
- `mcp-server/tests/gui/api-repos-store.test.ts` — new `describe('handleMoveRepo')` and `describe('handleGetRepo store_id enrichment')` sections

Deliverables:
- `handleMoveRepo` test suite: happy path (entry moves between registries with updated `last_modified`), no-op same-store, invalid target store → VALIDATION_ERROR, repo not found → NOT_FOUND, single-store mode → VALIDATION_ERROR, ID conflict in target → VALIDATION_ERROR, folder_name conflict in target → VALIDATION_ERROR.
- `handleGetRepo` enrichment tests: returns `store_id` in multi-store mode, omits `store_id` in single-store mode.

Estimated Complexity: Medium

Notes: These tests are independent of frontend WPs and can run in parallel with WP-004 through WP-006. They depend on WP-001 and WP-002 (the handlers must exist to be tested).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All seven `handleMoveRepo` scenarios are covered with assertions verifying the correct error code or successful registry state.
The happy-path test verifies the entry is absent from the source registry and present in the target registry after the move.
The no-op test verifies no registry writes occur when source and target stores are the same.
`handleGetRepo` multi-store test verifies `store_id` is present and matches the owning store.
`handleGetRepo` single-store test verifies `store_id` is absent from the response.
Tests follow the established pattern: `vi.mock` for `store-context.js`, real temp directories for I/O, `readRegistry()` helper for post-mutation verification.

summary: Added backend test coverage in `api-repos-store.test.ts`. The `handleMoveRepo` suite (all 7 scenarios: happy path, same-store no-op, invalid target store, repo not found, single-store mode, ID conflict, folder_name conflict) was already present from prior work. Added the missing `describe('handleGetRepo store_id enrichment')` section with two tests: multi-store mode returns `store_id` matching the owning store; single-store mode omits `store_id` from the response. All 4031 MCP server tests pass (4029 pre-existing + 2 new).

comments.note: The `handleMoveRepo` test suite (all 7 scenarios) was already present in the file prior to this WP, likely added alongside WP-002's implementation. This indicates good test-with-implementation discipline. The `handleGetRepo` single-store enrichment test was the only gap. No issues found.

summary: Verified all 7 handleMoveRepo test scenarios: AC-1 happy path (entry absent from source, present in target; last_modified updated), AC-2 same-store no-op (mtime guard confirms no writes), AC-3 invalid target_store_id → VALIDATION_ERROR with message identifying the unknown store, AC-4 NOT_FOUND for unknown repoId, AC-5 single-store mode (×2 variants) → VALIDATION_ERROR, AC-6 ID conflict in target → VALIDATION_ERROR, AC-7 folder_name conflict → VALIDATION_ERROR.
Verified handleGetRepo enrichment: multi-store returns store_id matching owning store; single-store mode result.store_id is undefined.

Confirmed test pattern compliance: vi.mock for store-context.js (hoisted, controls isStoreContextInitialized/getStoreRouter), real mkdtemp temp directories for I/O, readRegistry() helper for post-mutation registry assertions.
Regression: 4031/4031 tests pass across 145 test files.

comments.note: The mtime-based no-op guard in AC-2 (same-store move) is a strong test design choice — it proves the absence of writes without relying on mock spy call counts. No issues found.

summary: WP-004 passes code review. All 7 handleMoveRepo scenarios and both handleGetRepo enrichment tests are correctly implemented, well-isolated (vi.clearAllMocks + per-suite beforeEach/afterEach), and follow the established test pattern. Applied one Fix-Forward: promoted statSync to a top-level static import.

comments.note: reviewer-applied-fix: Promoted `statSync` from a dynamic in-test import (`const { statSync } = await import('node:fs')`) to a top-level static import. Dynamic import of a synchronous utility is semantically odd and adds unnecessary async overhead in the test body. No behavior change. 34/34 tests pass after fix.
The mtime-based no-op guard (AC-2) is a strong design choice — it proves the absence of writes without relying on spy call counts, which would couple the test to implementation details.

summary: Updated documentation for the new handleMoveRepo and handleGetRepo enrichment tests. (1) api-repos-store.test.ts header: appended AC-5 through AC-13 documenting the handleMoveRepo scenarios (7 cases) and handleGetRepo enrichment tests (2 cases) alongside the original WP-013 AC-1–AC-4 section. The api-surface.md handleGetRepo and handleMoveRepo TypeScript signatures were already accurate and required no changes.

comments.note: No observations — api-surface.md handleGetRepo and handleMoveRepo sections were already accurate. All documentation gaps were in file-tree.md (missing test file entry) and the test file header comment.

notes: WP-004 passes QA. All 6 ACs met: 7 handleMoveRepo scenarios + 2 handleGetRepo enrichment tests in mcp-server/tests/gui/api-repos-store.test.ts. Tests use vi.mock/real temp dirs/readRegistry() per the established pattern. 4031/4031 pass.
